outcome: Difference between functional and anatomic motor levels at 2 years of age
cohort: 72 neonates diagnosed with myelomeningocele at birth
finding: No significant benefit to motor function was found from cesarean delivery or avoidance of labor in infants with myelomeningocele.
mod_finding: While infants born vaginally or with a trial of labor had slightly lower (better) anatomic levels and smaller defects, this is likely attributable to selection bias.
